title: Qistas：面向大语言模型公平性评估的预注册可移植协议
summary: 提出Qistas协议，用于跨国家评估LLM对特定社会群体的公平性，以伊拉克为首个实例。采用配对反事实设计、置换检验等统计方法，并预先注册假设与分析方案。发布配套编写工具，首次实地测试发现25个模板组中24个存在缺陷。
summary_en: Presents Qistas, a portable, pre-registered protocol for evaluating LLM fairness toward a society's social, confessional, and regional groups, first instantiated for Iraq. It uses paired counterfactual designs with permutation tests, exact McNemar tests, and power analysis, and releases authoring apparatus; a field test found 24 of 25 template groups failed at least one check.
